_comment: Merged into $CLAUDE_HOME/settings.json by scripts/install.sh. Lists are unioned, never replaced. {{CLAUDE_HOME}} becomes the absolute config directory at merge time; in Edit and Write rules it is written with a leading '//' because a single '/' there means relative to the settings file. No rule here may grant a prefix that runs arbitrary commands (systemd-run, bare systemctl --user, bare agent-sandbox) or edits code the allowed commands then run (the driver's folder, .milestones/config); bootstrap.test.sh fails on one.

environment: **Milestone supervisor (routine)**: ~/.claude/skills/milestone-supervisor/run-milestones.sh launches autonomous Claude Code runs inside agent-sandbox containers (rootless Docker, disposable worktree, scoped IAM key) and passes --dangerously-skip-permissions to the agent inside by design; the container and the IAM boundary are the guardrails. Running that script and the `agent-sandbox` status, list, doctor, memlog, enter and run commands, and editing a project's .milestones/STATUS.md, notes-N.md and evaluation-N.md records, are routine supervisor work, not creating an unsafe agent. Editing the driver or a project's gate config (.milestones/config, config.local, standing-rules.md) is not routine and needs the owner
